packageRules.description: Angular ships as one versioned set. Splitting it across PRs produces peer-dependency conflicts that neither PR can resolve alone.
Same reasoning for Nx: the plugins must match the nx version exactly.

NgRx is pinned to 22.0.0-beta.0 because NgRx 21 peers on @angular/core@^21 and there is no stable NgRx 22 yet. This rule is what gets us off the beta: it accepts prereleases now, so a stable 22.x arrives as an ordinary upgrade PR the moment it is published.
Type definitions and lint tooling are safe to merge without review.
TypeScript minors regularly break Angular's compiler. Never automerge.
Node engine bumps change what CI and every contributor must install.
